prompt:
Platform integration ticket for VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1. We need a zero-dependency Java command-line client for VCF Automation that inventories every deployment before starting one deployment action. Add a single package-free source file, `AutomationClient.java`; use only JDK 17 APIs.

Research the live VCF Automation 9.1 xAPI reference on developer.broadcom.com before changing code. Read the official pages for Get Deployments V3, Submit Deployment Action Request, and Get Request. The repository pins the relevant reference-derived wire contract in `docs/contract.json` and records its provenance in `docs/official_sources.json`. Those files are protected. If the live pages differ from the pinned contract, mention the difference in your final response but implement the pinned contract. Cite the exact official page URLs you read.

`AutomationClient` must expose `public static void run(URI baseUri, String bearerToken, String deploymentId, String actionId, String reason, Duration pollDelay, PrintStream out)` and a normal `main(String[] args)` accepting, in order, base URL, bearer token, deployment ID, action ID, and reason. `main` should call `run` with a one-second polling delay.

The run behavior is: fetch every zero-based page from `GET /deployment/api/deployments` with `size=2` and `sort=name,asc`, stopping only when the response's `last` field is true; collect each deployment's `id` and `name`; and emit all deployments as JSON Lines sorted by Java string order on `name`, then `id`, so duplicate names are deterministic. Then submit `POST /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/requests` with the documented JSON body (`actionId`, empty `inputs`, and `reason`), take the returned request `id`, and poll `GET /deployment/api/requests/{requestId}` after each `pollDelay` until the request reaches a terminal status. The terminal statuses are exactly `APPROVAL_REJECTED`, `ABORTED`, `SUCCESSFUL`, and `FAILED`; `COMPLETION` is a non-terminal phase and must continue polling. Emit one final JSON line containing `requestId` and the terminal `status`. Preserve non-ASCII text and JSON-escape every emitted string.

Every request must send `Authorization: Bearer <bearerToken>`; the POST must use `Content-Type: application/json`. Treat interruption by restoring the thread interrupt flag and failing the run. Treat a non-2xx response or a malformed required response field as an error rather than emitting a result. Resolve paths relative to `baseUri` without contacting any other host.

`TestMain.java` is the protected acceptance harness. It starts only an ephemeral loopback mock, exercises all pages and all terminal statuses, and inspects the mock's request log. Run `java TestMain.java`; the completed implementation prints `all checks passed`. Do not modify `TestMain.java` or anything under `docs/`.

research.language_rationale: VCF Automation exposes this integration as REST; java.net.http.HttpClient supplies a JDK-only transport suitable for a single-file Java client.
